The original public prose or Final also gives the 48.3 and -1.9 component relation, but no calculator call executes that relation. Mentioning it is not an executed R route or independent cross-check. publication_alignment.explanation: The actual Final.value and actual referenced tool result agree. The direction and financial amount match the registered target.
